# rixl_api_key (Resource)

Manages a Rixl API key for authenticating API requests and CI/CD automation.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "rixl_api_key" "ci" {
  org_id     = var.rixl_org_id
  project_id = rixl_project.prod.id
  name       = "ci-uploader-key"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)
- `org_id` (String)

### Optional

- `expiring_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp, e.g. "2024-12-25T12:00:00Z".
- `project_id` (String)

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp, e.g. "2024-12-25T12:00:00Z".
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `last_used` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp, e.g. "2024-12-25T12:00:00Z".
- `permissions` (List of String)
- `policy_ids` (List of String)
- `project_name` (String)
- `secret` (String, Sensitive)
